title: Windy Mind route table v1 (payload of the ES256 JWS from GET /v1/route-table)
description: Routing INTENT for one caller. Never contains a secret, a key, or a provider URL except the authenticated standby floor. Additive changes only within v1; a breaking change bumps v and is announced to every consumer lane first. Source of truth: windy-mind/contracts; consumers vendor this file with a drift test.

stale_ok_s.description: How long chains/floors may be used when Mind is unreachable.

switched_off_stale_ok_s.description: Beyond this age with Mind unreachable, treat the named premium model as unknown and use the safe chain.

degraded.description: True when issued by the degraded standby.

caller.description: Passport id or owner switchboard id. Not secret.

named_model_fallback.description: Name of the chain a failed named model falls to.

switched_off.description: Model ids the caller (or the house) has switched off.
